name: DecodeME
lead_group: DecodeME Collaboration (Univ. Edinburgh, Ponting; LSHTM; Action for M.E.; ME Association; patients)
recruitment_years: from 2022 (online/postal questionnaire and saliva; end date not re-checked)
setting: community (online questionnaire, postal saliva kits; telephone support for the most severely ill)
case_definitions: CCC and/or IOM 2015 via questionnaire, after self-reported clinical diagnosis
severity_scale: NICE 2021 severity categories (self-report: impact on work, education, mobility, daily living)
severity_note: "Severity of ME/CFS (National Institute for Health and Care Excellence definitions): Mild 4,795 (28.7%); Moderate 9,731 (58.2%); Severe 2,073 (12.4%); Very severe 131 (0.8%)" of 16,730 genotyped cases passing QC. DecodeME preprint (medRxiv 10.1101/2025.08.06.25333109), Table 1, p.8-9 (local PDF downloads/decodeme/paper/). GWAS-1 itself used 15,579 cases.
onset_trigger: mixed: ~63% infection at/just before onset (glandular fever 16.3%, SARS-CoV-2 3.3%, other infection 43.1%)
access: summary statistics open (OSF rgqs3); individual data/recall via application (PRIME)
cites: Solving ME/CFS re-analysis (genetics_mr), using Kamitaki 2026 instruments, DecodeME and MVP
notes: decodeme.org.uk now serves gambling spam (see linkcheck.csv); use OSF/Edinburgh pages. Sardell 2026 and the MVP meta-analysis reuse these cases.

name: Million Veteran Program (CFS phenotype)
case_definitions: EHR-coded / self-reported CFS (no research case definition)
severity_note: No severity data. Combined DecodeME+MVP meta-analysis: 19,470 cases / 699,111 controls (catalogue decodeme-mvp-meta); MVP share not separately extracted.
access: summary statistics open (Zenodo 20204356); individual data restricted
cites: Solving ME/CFS re-analysis (genetics_mr), using Kamitaki 2026 instruments, DecodeME and MVP
notes: Pre-onset biobank samples exist for incident cases in principle (inventory: pre-onset); case validity low.

name: UK Biobank ME/CFS cases
lead_group: UK Biobank; analyses by Beentjes/Ponting (Edinburgh), Huang 2024, Dibble, Samms & Ponting
case_definitions: self-reported diagnosis and/or ICD-10 G93.3 in linked records
severity_note: No severity measure. n from Beentjes 2025 (EMBO Mol Med; "up to 1,455 cases vs 131,303"); inventory: 5,354 participants with any ME/CFS evidence; Pan-UKB 20002_1482 EUR 1,882 cases / 418,591 controls; Huang 2024: 1,194.
sampling_timing: single baseline visit (rest); incident cases sampled before diagnosis
data_types: routine biochemistry, blood counts, NMR metabolomics, Olink proteomics, genotypes
cites: Beentjes/Ponting 2025, EMBO Molecular Medicine (via Solving ME/CFS re-analysis)
notes: Prospective (pre-illness) only for the minority of incident cases diagnosed after baseline; healthy-volunteer bias.

name: FinnGen R12 / FinRegistry post-viral fatigue (G6_POSTVIRFAT)
case_definitions: ICD-10 G93.3 (postviral fatigue syndrome) in national registries
severity_note: No severity data. 283 cases / 463,029 controls (FinnGen R12 G6_POSTVIRFAT, catalogue finngen-r12); FinRegistry ~1,622 cases (Solving ME/CFS Risteys re-analysis).
data_types: GWAS summary statistics; registry endpoint enrichments
access: summary statistics open; individual data via FinnGen/Findata application
cites: Solving ME/CFS re-analysis (epi_literature; FinnGen R12 / FinRegistry)

name: NIH intramural post-infectious ME/CFS deep phenotyping
case_definitions: Fukuda 1994, CCC 2003 or IOM 2015, plus unanimous adjudication; onset after infection within the last five years
severity_scale: inclusion criterion only (moderate to severe impairment)
severity_note: Inclusion required "moderate to severe cl[inical impairment]" (Walitt 2024 Nat Commun, Methods, PMC10881493); no per-class counts. GEO SomaScan sets contain 21 patients (4 not adjudicated).
illness_duration: onset within 5 years of enrolment (inclusion); median not extracted
sampling_timing: rest plus exercise/grip/effort tasks; CSF and muscle sampled
sample_types: plasma, serum, CSF, PBMC, muscle biopsy, stool
data_types: SomaScan proteomics, metabolomics (CSF), flow cytometry, PBMC/muscle RNA-seq, stool metagenome and IgG-seq, physiology, imaging
access: open (supplementary/source data, GEO, MW); more via mapMECFS
cites: Solving ME/CFS re-analysis of Walitt 2024 NIH stool [doi:10.1038/s41467-024-45107-3]
notes: Atlas comprehensive_studies lists severity as "mild-moderate; strict entry criteria". Very small n.

name: Cornell ME/CFS Collaborative Research Center two-day CPET cohort
lead_group: Cornell University (Hanson, Grimson, De Vlaminck) with Ithaca College (Keller)
case_definitions: CCC (per Cornell CRC papers; not re-checked per paper)
severity_note: Computed by us from per-person Bell scores in the Germain 2022 JCI Insight supplement (jci.insight.2022.xlsx, "Original Dataset" sheet, 60 cases): median 37.5, IQR 27.5-40; Bell <=30 n=29, <=20 n=15, <=10 n=1. Bell anchors: 30 "usually confined to house", 10 "bedridden the majority of the time", so these are not NICE classes and are not entered as housebound/bedbound counts. Keller 2024 (84 cases) Table 1: "Bell Activity Scale 33.9 (11.0) | 39.3 (15.4) | 35.2 (12.4)" (female | male | total, mean SD). Giloteaux 2024 EV: "Bell Disability Scale Median (IQR) 30 (17.5)". Glass 2025: "38.7 ± 16.7". All participants had to complete two maximal CPETs, so bedbound patients are effectively excluded.
sampling_timing: before and after two maximal CPETs 24 h apart (15 min and 24 h post), day 1 and day 2
sample_types: plasma, PBMC, extracellular vesicles, cell-free RNA
data_types: Metabolon metabolomics, SomaScan 7k proteomics, EV proteomics, scRNA-seq, scATAC, cfRNA, CPET physiology
access: per-person metabolomics in supplement (open); proteome/EV via publication; GEO open
cites: Hanson 2016, J Transl Med (reply on Billing-Ross 2016) [doi:10.1186/s12967-016-1104-5]
notes: Paper-level n differ (Germain 2022 60/45; Germain 2025 79/53 at baseline 78/51; Giloteaux 2024 18/17 women; Glass 2025 10/12 men; Vu 2024 scRNA 30/28 (our GEO metadata: cases 20 F/10 M); GSE268212 7/7; Gardella 2025 cfRNA 93/75). Cohort n given as the largest single paper (Keller 2024, 84/71). Bell numbers above are from Germain 2022 only.

notes: Hoel 2021 metabolomics used 83 RituxME patients and 35 HC; its Table 1 severity is not in the PMC XML. pct_female computed from 6-y follow-up participants (96/116). RituxME required disease duration >=5 y for mild cases (Rekeland 2024).

PF bands are not severity classes.

Subsets: Lee JS 2025 "Mild/Moderate (n = 43) | Severe (n = 53)"; Dibble 2024 and Bourgonje 2024 40 severe each; BCR PRJEB83659 37 severe / 31 mild-moderate; TCR PRJNA940635 ~37-38 severe per cell type.
